mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalUserCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_DAYS(create_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW()) THEN 1 END) AS todayNewUserCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(create_time) = 1 THEN 1 END) AS yesterdayNewUserCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') THEN 1 END) AS monthNewUserCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(create_time) < 7 THEN 1 END) AS sevenDayNewUserCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(create_time) < 30 THEN 1 END) AS thirtyDayNewUserCount FROM user_info WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS timePoint, COUNT(id) AS newUserCount FROM user_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY timePoint ORDER BY timePoint
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND last_login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
